messages:
maya: Heads-up: the onboarding sample-app we hand out to customers fails on Cloudflare Workers with "Cannot find module 'crypto'". Repro steps: wrangler publish -> runtime error during request.

kevin: That's because Workers is a web worker environment — no node: or built-in node modules. Our SDK still imports node:crypto in a couple places for hashing and random. We need a thin ESM worker build that uses Web Crypto.

sam: For a PoC we used an import map to redirect node:crypto to a tiny shim. Example import map snippet we used: 
```json
{"imports":{"node:crypto":"/poly/node-crypto-shim.mjs"}}
```
and the shim implements only the bits we need via crypto.getRandomValues and crypto.subtle.digest. Kept bundle < 3KB.

lisa: TS gotcha: projects that set lib without webworker lose types for crypto.subtle. Recommend sample tsconfig includes: 
{"compilerOptions":{"lib":["es2021","webworker"]}}
otherwise you get type errors.

maya: Another issue: a few SDK helpers assume Buffer exists. That trips in Workers. We should replace Buffer usage with Uint8Array/TextEncoder in the edge build.

kevin: Also watch bundler platform flags. esbuild with platform: 'node' injects CJS interop and can leave runtime require() calls. Build for platform: 'neutral' and format: 'esm' for Worker targets.

sam: Important operational note: don't pull in large polyfills (crypto-browserify, buffer polyfill) — Workers have script size limits and those slow cold starts. Tiny shims that call native Web APIs are preferred.

lisa: For testing locally, Miniflare + wrangler is the closest match. Use `miniflare --wrangler` to emulate. Also add an automated smoke test in CI that runs the sample against Miniflare.

maya: Proposal: add a new dist entrypoint `sdk.edge.mjs` (ESM-only) that exports the same surface but uses web-friendly implementations for crypto/text encoding. Update package.json exports to point to it for `browser`/edge resolutions. Include a short README snippet for deploying to Workers (import map, wrangler.toml snippet, tsconfig).

kevin: I'll draft the PR. I'll include a tiny shim implementation, rollup/esbuild configs for `format: 'esm'`, and the CI Miniflare smoke test. @maya can you review the sample app and README changes?

maya: Will do. I'll swap Buffer usages and add tests.

devex-bot: deploy-bot: preview updated for sample-app -> https://preview-sample-app.workers.dev :rocket:

sam: Sounds good. Once PR is up, put a link in #devex and tag eng-runtime for perf review.
